title: Venezuelan Man Faces 20 Years for Alleged $1B Crypto Money Laundering Scheme
summary: Federal prosecutors charged Venezuelan national Jorge Figueira with laundering approximately $1 billion through cryptocurrency wallets and shell companies, marking one of the largest money-laundering operations prosecuted by the Justice Department.The postVenezuelan Man Faces 20 Years for Alleged $1B Crypto Money Laundering Schemeappeared first onCryptonews.
